q: Getting a teaching _____ requires at least four years of college study.
explain: qualification n. 资格，资历；限定条件。
translation: 取得教师资格至少需要四年的大学学习。

q: She _____ for the national team after winning the local competition.
explain: qualify v. （使）具有资格；取得资格。
translation: 在赢得当地比赛后，她成功入选了国家队。

q: The _____ of the air in the city has improved greatly this year.
explain: quality n. 质量；品质，素质。
translation: 今年这个城市的空气质量有了很大改善。

q: A large _____ of rain fell on the region during the storm last night.
translation: 昨晚的暴风雨给这个地区带来了大量的降雨。

q: A _____ of the students in the class were absent because of the flu.
explain: quarter n. 四分之一；一刻钟；季度。
translation: 班上四分之一的学生因为流感缺席了。

q: The teacher asked a difficult _____ about the causes of World War Two.
explain: question n. 问题 / v. 询问，质疑。
translation: 老师提出了一个关于二战起因的艰深问题。

q: The police _____ the witness for more than two hours at the station.
explain: question n. 问题 / v. 询问，质疑。
translation: 警察在警局询问了目击者两个多小时。

q: We need to find a _____ solution to this problem before it gets worse.
translation: 我们需要在问题恶化之前找到一个快速的解决办法。

q: The library is a _____ place where students can focus on their work.
explain: quiet adj. 安静的 / n. 宁静 / v. 使安静。
translation: 图书馆是一个安静的地方，学生可以专心学习。

q: The _____ of the countryside helps me relax after a busy week in the city.
explain: quiet adj. 安静的 / n. 宁静 / v. 使安静。
translation: 在城市里忙碌了一周后，乡村的宁静帮助我放松下来。

q: The mother _____ the baby by singing a soft song before bedtime.
explain: quiet adj. 安静的 / n. 宁静 / v. 使安静。
translation: 妈妈在睡前唱了一首轻柔的歌，让宝宝安静下来。

q: He is _____ his job to start his own business next month.
explain: quit v. 停止；辞职，放弃。
translation: 他打算下个月辞去工作，开始自己创业。

q: The movie was _____ good, though it was a little longer than expected.
translation: 这部电影相当不错，只是比预期的长了一点。

q: The writer began her article with a famous _____ about the power of imagination.
explain: quote n. 引文，引语 / v. 引用，引述。
translation: 这位作家以一句关于想象力力量的著名引语开始了她的文章。

q: The newspaper _____ the official saying that the project would continue.
explain: quote n. 引文，引语 / v. 引用，引述。
translation: 报纸援引那位官员的话说，这个项目将会继续。
